div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-system-property-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Indicates whether the AI system or relevant regulated product is documented as bearing a CE marking.
Identifies the notified body involved in the applicable conformity-assessment procedure, where relevant.
Identifies the expected operational lifetime of the AI system or software component.
Identifies the purpose for which the AI system is intended to be used according to the provider's documentation.
Identifies the population for which the AI system is intended or validated to be used.
